title: Automated Logistics Document Processing
business: Logistics and supply chain firms managing high volumes of international shipping manifests.
problem: Manual data entry of handwritten shipping manifests is slow, error-prone, and creates bottlenecks in customs clearance.
solution: Deploying Llama 3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct to automatically extract text and key-value pairs from scanned shipping documents to accelerate processing.
steps: Verify the organization has fewer than 700 million monthly active users to comply with the Llama 3.2 Community License.
Integrate the model into the document pipeline to process scanned images of manifests.
Include the required attribution notice in a 'Notice' text file within the software distribution.
Display 'Built with Llama' prominently on the internal dashboard or public-facing service interface.
Ensure all usage adheres to the Acceptable Use Policy and local trade compliance regulations.
outcome: Increased throughput of document processing with reduced manual intervention and higher data accuracy.
limitation: The model may hallucinate details on low-quality scans; performance must be checked by implementing a human-in-the-loop verification step for low-confidence extractions.
